mechanism: Erythromycin is a CYP3A4 inhibitor that may increase olmesartan exposure, though olmesartan is minimally metabolized; however, both drugs can cause gastrointestinal effects and erythromycin may prolong QT interval.
action: Monitor blood pressure control and electrolytes; consider alternative antibiotic if QT prolongation is a concern; olmesartan dose adjustment is typically unnecessary.
